subject: Control dependency decision log & evidence request for upcoming FedRAMP scoping
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa@acme-audit.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: samir.patel@norskebanksec.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: control dependency decision log + sample list for FedRAMP scoping

Jordan —

Following our kickoff call, NorskBank’s FedRAMP intake team asked that we produce two artifacts before the scoping workshop next Tuesday: (1) a control dependency decision log (which control implementations we accept vs. which require compensating controls or customer-side responsibilities), and (2) a short sample list of evidence we will provide for those high-risk controls so they can size their audit sampling.

To keep the scoping call efficient, can you share a draft decision log and a one-page sample evidence list by EOD Monday (May 24)? If there are controls you need owners for, please call those out so we can triage during the meeting. The intake team prefers CSV for the decision log and a PDF for the sample list.

Thanks — I know this is tight.

—Lisa Chen
Senior Engagement Manager
Acme Audit Partners

Attachment: template-decision-log.csv (CSV template, 4 KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@acme-audit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: control dependency decision log + sample list for FedRAMP scoping

Hi Lisa —

Acknowledged. We'll provide the CSV decision log and a one-pager PDF with sample evidence. High-level approach:

- Marissa will drive the control mapping and populate the CSV for controls in scope (especially identity, key management, logging).
- Mina will own evidence pulls for infrastructure controls (network segmentation, VPC flow logs).
- I'll own the decisions that affect product behavior (default encryption, customer opt-in for BYOK, caching TTLs).

Quick asks for your intake team so we align format:
1) For decision "Accept/Compensate/CustomerResponsibility", do you need an explicit justification field (short sentence) per row?
2) For sampling size, does NorskBank want control-level file references (filename + path) or an index that points into a single evidence bundle?

We'll aim to push a first cut by end of day Monday.

Jordan Blake
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Lisa Chen <lisa@acme-audit.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: control dependency log + sample evidence list (attached)

Jordan / Lisa —

Attached are the initial artifacts: control-dependency-log.csv and a one-page sample-evidence-refs.pdf. Notes:

- Column set in the CSV: control_id, control_desc, proposed_decision (Accept / Compensate / CustomerResponsibility), decision_owner, justification, evidence_refs (comma-separated).
- I filled decisions for inventory of 35 controls we have confidence on; 7 controls are flagged as "needs-owner" — see rows 12, 19, 27.
- Samples PDF contains 12 example files we can reasonably surface quickly (log extracts, KMS key policy screenshots, SOC 2 test results summary).

Attachments:
- control-dependency-log.csv (CSV, 13 KB)
- sample-evidence-refs.pdf (PDF, 88 KB)

Open questions for the intake team:
- If a control maps to customer responsibility, do we include a short mitigation note to capture recommended customer config? (I.e., for customer-managed IAM, provide config snippet.)
- For controls we mark "Compensate", I added a short compensating control note column — is that acceptable for scoping?

If this format works, I'll tidy the CSV headers and push a Drive folder link with file-level read permissions to the audit team.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: control-dependency-log.csv (CSV, 13 KB); sample-evidence-refs.pdf (PDF, 88 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa@acme-audit.com>, samir.patel@norskebanksec.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: control dependency log + sample evidence list (attached)

Thanks for the fast turnaround — this looks good. A couple of operational decisions we need to lock down before scoping:

- Decision owners: Jordan, please confirm you’re OK owning product-behavior decisions and sign off on any "Accept" rows that rely on defaults we ship.
- Archive path: we will publish the canonical evidence bundle to the compliance Drive link (see below) and use short references in the CSV (no full paths in the spreadsheet). That keeps the CSV small and audit-friendly.
- Sampling: for high-risk controls (IDs 3, 7, 19) we should pre-select 3 representative artifacts each. Marissa / Mina — please annotate the CSV evidence_refs column with the short ref token (e.g., DB-LOG-2027-04-12).

Once Jordan confirms owner assignments I’ll mark the decision log as "ready for intake" and share the Drive link with NorskBank.

Drive (internal): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-control-deps

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
